name: Red-Bellied Orchid Plover
desc: A small bird of Snezhnaya, named for the color of its plumage.\nRed-Bellied Blue Plovers chirp occasionally, their calls slow, soft, and slightly sorrowful. As a result, in the writings of a Poet, they always seem to be singing for someone's tragedy.\nOf course, these verses are mostly romantic human interpretations. Red-Bellied Blue Plovers are innocent by nature, swift in flight, and remarkably resilient. Woodlands, orchards, and the water's edge can all serve as their habitat. And in the life of a Red-Bellied Blue Plover, there is perhaps nothing more important than foraging.
